title: Restore Product Editor styling and modal opacity

requirements.summary: Update global theme tokens so primary buttons render clearly blue (not purple) with readable contrast in light and dark themes.
acceptanceCriteria: In light theme, primary buttons render with a clearly blue fill (not purple) and meet readable contrast against button text.
In dark theme, primary buttons still render blue and remain readable (no low-contrast text).
Buttons that use the default variant (e.g., ProductsWorkspace “Generate All Products”, ProductEditor “Generate”) visually match the updated blue primary color without additional per-button overrides.

file_operations.description: Adjust global CSS color tokens for --primary and related tokens (e.g., --ring if needed) in both :root and .dark to a consistent blue hue, ensuring primary button backgrounds and focus rings render blue with strong text contrast across light/dark themes.

requirements.summary: Restore a non-white surfaced look for the Product Editor workspace and ensure the editor card remains visually distinct from the background.
acceptanceCriteria: The Product Editor workspace area has a visible surface treatment (e.g., muted/tinted container or subtle gradient) so the page does not look like flat white-on-white in light theme.
The ProductEditor card remains visually distinct from the surrounding page (clear border/shadow/surface separation).
No changes to product editing functionality, autosave behavior, or generation logic.

file_operations.description: Update the top-level workspace container styling to add a subtle surface treatment (e.g., muted/tinted panel background, gradient, and/or border) that works with existing theme tokens, improving separation from the page background without affecting workspace logic.

Refine the ProductEditor Card styling (background, border, shadow) to maintain clear visual separation from the workspace surface in light/dark themes while keeping all editor behaviors and handlers unchanged.

requirements.summary: Make the Instructions modal panel fully opaque and legible by applying solid background and appropriate border/shadow styling to DialogContent.
acceptanceCriteria: When the Instructions modal is open, the modal panel (DialogContent) has an opaque background and text is clearly readable over the page behind it.
The Instructions modal retains its existing responsive sizing and scrolling behavior (no regression to scrollability on tablet/touch).
No change to the Instructions content structure or navigation behavior; only visual/legibility fixes.

file_operations.description: Update DialogContent class composition to enforce an opaque panel surface (solid bg using theme tokens) and add border/shadow as needed; preserve current responsive width/max-height, flex layout, and the scrollable content container to avoid regressions.
